newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area early Thursday, USDA said.

Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 200 slaughter steers and 200 heifers; 129,300 head confirmed for week to date which includes 15,000 formulated and 1,500 previously contract cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 63.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 63.00.
